Class UCharacter.UnicodeBlock

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Character.Subset
com.ibm.icu.lang.UCharacter.UnicodeBlock
Enclosing class:
UCharacter
public static final class UCharacter.UnicodeBlock extends Character.Subset
[icu enhancement] ICU's replacement for java.lang.Character.UnicodeBlock. Methods, fields, and other functionality specific to ICU are labeled '[icu]'.

A family of character subsets representing the character blocks in the Unicode specification, generated from Unicode Data file Blocks.txt. Character blocks generally define characters used for a specific script or purpose. A character is contained by at most one Unicode block.

[icu] Note: All fields named XXX_ID are specific to ICU.

Author:
Syn Wee Quek
Status:
Stable ICU 2.4.

      public static UCharacter.UnicodeBlock getInstance(int id)
      [icu] Returns the only instance of the UnicodeBlock with the argument ID. If no such ID exists, a INVALID_CODE UnicodeBlock will be returned.
      Parameters:
      id - UnicodeBlock ID
      Returns:
      the only instance of the UnicodeBlock with the argument ID if it exists, otherwise a INVALID_CODE UnicodeBlock will be returned.
      Status:
      Stable ICU 2.4.

    • of

      public static UCharacter.UnicodeBlock of(int ch)
      Returns the Unicode allocation block that contains the code point, or null if the code point is not a member of a defined block.
      Parameters:
      ch - code point to be tested
      Returns:
      the Unicode allocation block that contains the code point
      Status:
      Stable ICU 2.4.

    • forName

      public static final UCharacter.UnicodeBlock forName(String blockName)
      Alternative to the Character.UnicodeBlock.forName(String) method. Returns the Unicode block with the given name.

      [icu] Note: Unlike Character.UnicodeBlock.forName(String), this only matches against the official UCD name and the Java block name (ignoring case).

      Parameters:
      blockName - the name of the block to match
      Returns:
      the UnicodeBlock with that name
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the blockName could not be matched
      Status:
      Stable ICU 3.0.

    • getID

      Returns:

      Status:
